{"consolidated_memory":"**CONSOLIDATED: Intermittent EOF in crypto/tls/handshake.go - Four Separate Occasions**

Component: crypto/tls/handshake.go (security side)
Covering test: crypto/tls/handshake_test.go
Common repro: open many short lived connections in a row
Common signal: unexpected end of stream during negotiation (intermittent EOF in handshake)

---

**OCCASION 1: [2026-02-08]**
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: config loader reading wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #3415, branch fix/intermittent-eof-1
- Result: 67 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

**OCCASION 2: [2026-07-14]**
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: cache entry never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #3892, branch fix/intermittent-eof-2
- Result: the alert stayed quiet for 22 consecutive days

**OCCASION 3: [2026-07-20]**
- Trigger: occurred only on the staging read replica
- Root cause: two writes never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #6826, branch fix/intermittent-eof-3
- Result: the nightly rollup matched the source counts for 27 days running

**OCCASION 4: [2026-08-13]**
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #7817, branch fix/intermittent-eof-4
- Result: the job finished in 39 minutes instead of 4 hours"}
